+ ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[mbid]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[medicaid_id]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[medicaid_state_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_first_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_last_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_middle_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_name_suffix]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_date_of_birth]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_sex]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_address1]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_address2]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_city]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_state]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_zip_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_zip_code_extn]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_address1]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_address2]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_city]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_state]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_zip_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_zip_code_extn]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_primary_phone]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_email]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[plan_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[plan_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[attributed_cco]),\'\') AS DATA, 1 AS ORDERNUM FROM ##MO_SDOH_FINAL) A ORDER BY ORDERNUM',

	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
